author: Garys Economics
description:
Alright everyone.  Last video.  I did this one totally unscripted so I forgot a few important things and then I wrote a really long description to fill that all in and YT told me it was too long 😫 so here's the important points.

1 - THANKS.  To everyone - to all of you who watch and share, to Oscar, Jack, Tom, Hattie who work on the channel.  To the Patreons who work on all this.  To Rebecca Gowland and PMUK and Faiza Shaheen and TJUK and Gabriel Zucman and his team and everyone who works on/supports this.

2 - BURNHAM.  I know we are pausing the channel now for a long time but I'll make an exception for you (or maybe even your chancellor).  We all want you to succeed.

3. FUTURE PLANS.  Channel is down for now, but not forever.  I'm working on some other cool stuff too which will come out at some point.  I'll be here as long as the economy keeps collapsing, after that I turn this into a Japanese Language learning channel.  心配しないで。諦めないで。

4.  PATREON.  Special big thanks to all Patre
title: It's time to say goodbye
